about: The LIN-73 prototype's 46 chat messages with the answers Jev should give. Each row of tuned and new is [message, relation, side, gender, subject, wants_count]. tuned (32) are the messages the wording was tuned on; new (14) were held out. The names are changed from the owner's tree to the made-up test tree in src/lib/fixtures/kinshipFixtureTree.ts. One change from the prototype: 'who are Maya's aunts on the Aziz side' (prototype: the Pharoan side) expects side family_name, not maternal: a side named by a family cluster goes to the model, and the code does not guess a side (LIN-73).
